name: Moving pictures
line: Every round's tile is a still from its own film in which one thing keeps moving (turbine blades, a record needle, a crown's glint), like a Harry Potter portrait: the record looks alive, and each tile says 'there is a film behind me'.

name: The closing bell
line: Panel 3 grades the round in front of you: the bell rings, the market's move lands, the stamps slam PASS or FAIL one by one, the winner's tag drops. It plays once, silently; a tap on the bell plays it with sound.

name: Since your last visit
line: Come back and Meet the models opens as you left it, then the cards overtake into today's order while the money rolls to today's figure; the rounds graded since carry a NEW stamp. You see what changed without reading.

name: The golden ticket in your hand
line: Tilt the phone and only #1's ticket catches the light: it leans with the phone, its gold foil slides through its colours and a glint runs across it. The other tickets stay flat paper.

name: Page turn
line: A tap on a tab turns a page of the same comic book (going back lays the earlier page down again), so Overview, Leaderboard and Upcoming read as one story, not three sites.

name: Talking portraits
line: Typing dots beside each face say it has something to say; tap the face and it tells you its calls for the next close (#1 speaks once by itself). The newest predictions, right on the cast.

name: Scroll plays the season
line: Your thumb is the clock: scrolling runs the season from round 1 to today, each face riding its own line, the coin rolling on the 50% line, the round ticking over on the cursor. Scroll back and it rewinds.

name: Wet ink
line: A round's stamp stays wet for a day after its close: a slow gloss, a soft bleed, a drop of ink while it is only hours old, drying with the hours. The newest rounds stand out with no 'new' label.
